# Universal Perk

> Universal Perk is a US-based software development company. One team
> builds web apps, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure, and AI systems for
> growing businesses, so clients aren't assembling several vendors to get
> one product built.

We work with businesses that have a real, specific problem to solve —
not just "we want AI" or "we want a website" in the abstract. Typical
starting points: calls going unanswered after hours, manual document
processing eating staff time, a legacy system that's become too fragile
to change safely, or a founder who needs a working product in front of
customers fast. The service list below is broad on purpose; what's narrow
is the problem each client brings us.

We handle sensitive data. We build to HIPAA requirements and will sign a
Business Associate Agreement before any work touches patient data. We are
not SOC 2 certified, and we do not claim "HIPAA certified" — no such
vendor certification exists.

## Services

- Web & software development
- Mobile app development (iOS and Android)
- Cloud migration & infrastructure
- AI solutions & embedded engineers, including voice AI and document
  processing/parsing
- Data science & machine learning
- Technical consulting and roadmap planning

## Proof of work

- [DASGUZO](/dasguzo) — a peer-to-peer car rental platform taken from
  concept to a live web + mobile product in 90 days.
- [WMTFA](/wmtfa) — a custom CRM that unified 7 systems for a
  multinational nonprofit and added AI-driven reporting.
- [Creva.ai](/creva) — an AI recruiting platform: resume screening, AI
  voice interviews, and candidate scoring, built and shipped end to end.
